Our Story

"Fashion should be
effortless, expressive,
and timeless."

Aiki's Fashion Boutique was born from a simple belief: every woman deserves to feel extraordinary every single day — not just on special occasions, but in the quiet, in-between moments that make up a life.

It began with a wardrobe problem that so many Filipino women know well: beautiful clothes that don't quite fit our bodies, our weather, our pace of life. Too stiff. Too foreign. Too much. We wanted something different — pieces that felt like they were made for us.

How We Started

Founded in Manila by a small team of fashion lovers and stylists, Aiki's started as a curated edit of handpicked pieces sourced with intention. What began as a passion project quickly grew into a community of women who shared the same longing — for clothes that were elevated without being unreachable, modern without losing warmth.

We opened our first boutique with just a handful of designs. Today, we carry over 39 curated pieces across women's dresses, co-ord sets, bags, and men's wear — each chosen or designed with the same obsessive attention to fit, fabric, and feel.

Our Vision

We believe luxury is not a price point. It is a feeling — of being seen, of moving through the world with confidence, of choosing clothes that reflect who you truly are. Our vision is to make that feeling accessible to every Filipino woman, wherever she is in life.

We are building more than a boutique. We are building a standard — for quality, for craftsmanship, and for the kind of style that doesn't chase trends but creates them.

Policies

Returns & Exchange

We want you to love every piece from Aiki's. If something isn't quite right, we're here to make it easy. Please read our full policy below before initiating a return or exchange.

📅Return Window
+

We accept returns within 7 days from the date you received your order. Items requested after the 7-day window will not be eligible for return or exchange.

The return window begins on the day your tracking shows delivered.

✔Eligible Items
+

To qualify for a return or exchange, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed, and unaltered
  • In original condition with all tags attached
  • Free from perfume, makeup, or deodorant stains
  • In original packaging (if applicable)
✖Non-Returnable Items
+

The following items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged:

  • Sale or discounted items
  • Intimate wear and swimwear
  • Accessories (bags, jewelry)
  • Items marked as "Final Sale" at checkout
  • Items with visible signs of wear or washing
↻Exchange Policy
+

We gladly offer size or color exchanges within 7 days, subject to stock availability.

  • Exchanges are processed once the original item is received and inspected
  • If your preferred size/color is unavailable, you will receive store credit
  • Exchange shipping fee is shouldered by the customer
📦How to Return
+
  1. Email us at returns@aikisfashion.com within 7 days with your order number and reason for return
  2. Wait for our confirmation and return instructions (within 1–2 business days)
  3. Pack the item securely in its original packaging
  4. Ship the item to our address using a trackable courier
  5. Send us the tracking number once shipped

Return shipping cost is the responsibility of the customer unless the item is defective or incorrectly sent.

💵Refund Method & Timeline
+

Once we receive and inspect your return, we will notify you within 2–3 business days.

Approved refunds are processed as:

  • Store Credit — issued within 1 business day (recommended)
  • Original Payment Method — GCash or bank transfer within 5–7 business days

Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Need help with a return?

Our team is happy to assist you through the process. Reach out to us and we'll respond within 24 hours.

How to Measure

€Bust

Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape parallel to the ground. Do not pull too tight.

€Waist

Measure around the narrowest part of your natural waist, usually about 2.5 cm above your belly button.

€Hips

Stand with feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips, approximately 20 cm below your waist.

€Length

Measured from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem of the garment when laid flat.

All measurements are in cm and inches. For suits and formal wear, we recommend professional tailoring measurements for the best fit.

How to Measure

€Chest

Measure around the fullest part of your chest, under your arms, keeping the tape parallel to the ground.

€Waist

Measure around your natural waistline, keeping one finger between the tape and your body for comfort.

€Inseam

Measure from the crotch seam down to the bottom of the ankle, or use a well-fitting pair of trousers as reference.

€Shoulder

Measure from the edge of one shoulder seam to the other, across the back. Best done with help.

Bag dimensions are measured in cm and inches — Width × Height × Depth. All measurements are approximate and may vary slightly by style.

What Fits Inside?

€ Mini & Crossbody

Phone, cards, keys, lip gloss, compact. Perfect for evenings and light daily use.

€ Satchel & Top Handle

Phone, wallet, keys, small notebook, makeup pouch. Great for work or brunch.

€ Tote & Shoulder Bag

All of the above plus a tablet, planner, water bottle, or small umbrella.

€ Care Tip

Store bags stuffed with tissue when not in use. Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve color.
